added.summary: Typed Unicode-scalar attribute ranges feed the shared paragraph shaper directly, without markup conversion. Overlapping part declarations inherit independently, colour tokens follow the active style, unknown attributes and zero-length markers remain metadata, and wave, shake and pulse reuse checkpointed tick motion and reduced-motion handling. TextSpan is generated for stores on both hosts; rendering is exposed through the Svelte text spans binding, not a new TypeScript UI builder.
